$comment: pnpm notices (scripts/notices.ts). The licence allow-list is `accepted` in about.toml, next to this file.

web.$comment: Vite modes the front end is built in: the installed Satchel and Satchel Dev.
web.$virtualModules: Bundler-generated modules and the package (a > b: b as found from a) whose code they are.
web.$packages: Per-package adjustments. licenseEnd: keep the licence file up to this line (Vite's file goes on to list the licences of its own bundled build tools, none of which ship). extraFiles: also include these files.

vite.note: Only Vite's module preload helper is in Satchel.

rolldown.note: Only Rolldown's module runtime helpers are in Satchel.

web.$embedded: Code copied into another package. Its licence is the comment at the top of `module`, which must be in the bundle.
